optical.source: ESA Copernicus via Microsoft Planetary Computer (open catalogue, no account)
optical.note: Dry-season picture of the landscape, taken before the flood. It is not a picture of the flood.

radar.sensor: Sentinel-1A C-band SAR, VH, RTC gamma-0
radar.note: Radar sees smooth water as dark. These are the same passes the flood layer was computed from, scaled for display only.
